topic.title: Prompt Group Sizes: Is it always exactly 18 texts per prompt?
topic.author: ナハト・ ファウスト

raw.title: Prompt Group Sizes: Is it always exactly 18 texts per prompt?
Prompt Group Sizes: Is it always exactly 18 texts per prompt?

forumTopic.authorUserDisplayName: ナハト・ ファウスト

comments.content: Yes, the Overview line already answers the test-side question. On train, 149 of 150 prompts have 18 answers and one prompt has 17 (claude-fable-5 is the short model). That can make train look like neat rounds. Public and private do not promise a full 18-model group, and model counts are unequal, so anything that forces one of each label per prompt on test is fitting a structure the test set does not have.

comments.content:
Mentioned on Overview page.

The number of test passages per model is not equal, and the mix of models differs between the public and private leaderboard. Balanced accuracy gives every model the same weight.

So yeah not all prompts will have an output by every model, worst case can be 4000 totally seperate prompts.
